release_scope: Standalone, bounded, read-only ZIP structure and selected text inspection

provenance.cross_snapshot_comparison: Code and tests byte-identical in three archived snapshots; the GPLv3 license byte-identical in all six.

explicit_exclusions: Full project regression suite (previously 84 of 85 passed on Python 3.13.5)
limitations: This is not a malware sandbox, cryptographic signature checker or full secret scanner.
JSON output can include sensitive source contents not matched by heuristic filters.
A missing archive yields awaiting_archive with exit code 0, not evidence of a successful inspection.
The historical known-hash comparison is informational, not an authenticity guarantee.
Test claims are limited to the stated Python version, unit cases and smoke cases.
